priority_pages.label: Alternative data tools for angel investors
priority_pages.quote: For a careful angel investor, the best alternative data stack in 2026 is not the biggest one. It is the one that gives earlier signal first, verification second, and complexity only when needed.

priority_pages.label: Startup engineering momentum
priority_pages.quote: Startup engineering momentum is not just more commits. It is the pattern behind shipping intensity, contributor growth, and visible build activity that suggests something real is changing inside a startup before the public story fully catches up.

priority_pages.label: Timing vs verification
priority_pages.quote: Verification helps you understand what already happened. Timing helps you notice what is changing earlier.

priority_pages.label: GitHub signals for angel investors
priority_pages.quote: You do not need to read code line by line to use GitHub signals well. What matters is noticing when public engineering behavior starts changing in a way that could matter before the market story fully catches up.

priority_pages.label: GitHub Scout Score
priority_pages.quote: A GitHub Scout Score is not a measure of whether you are a good engineer. It is a lightweight taste signal built from what you have starred and how that pattern overlaps with meaningful startup outcomes.
